questions.question: $\sin^{2}30^{\circ}+\cos^{2}60^{\circ}-\tan^{2}45^{\circ}$ is (a) 1  (b) 0  (c) $\frac{1}{2}$  (d) $-\frac{1}{2}$
questions.knowledgeNote: $\sin^{2}30^{\circ}=\cos^{2}60^{\circ}=\frac14$ and $\tan^{2}45^{\circ}=1$, which changes the sign of such expressions.
